title: ID0423840-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5 313662781001] Technical Query
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Can you please send us the MAC address of the ocpp router of the
charger?
The MAC address is needed for the internet connection via cable, to
be able to configure the backend connection.
But the MAC address cannot be seen in the Router configuration in
SCB.
https://configuration.sicharge.technology/chargers/4e4ika/detail
Solution: Provide MAC address found in the Device tab in Router via SSH
